discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 of B005 (packets 205, 409). 30 standard searches, snippets only. Holds released with new per-pin evidence (keys held in 409): oe/duchess, oe/marie (per-pin descriptions), oe/abu-, genie-, jasmine-april-2019 (own line items), oe/aladdin-april-2019 (actually Jasmine & Aladdin one pin), oe-set/phantom-manor-2019 (three pins described), oe/jack-and-sally (one pin), christmas-2019-winnie-the-pooh x3, annual-pass-christmas-2019 (two pins split), lion-king-jungle-festival-2019/clarice (LE 500). Princesses Day ten pins added: source says each remaining pin shows a single princess. PTC May PTN names attributed to the DPB May PTN page per search summary.
